protocol.fresh_amg: fresh hierarchy and lazy coarse solve per field and repeat; no benchmark instrumentation
protocol.fresh_oracle: CSC conversion, sparse factorization, and solve per field and repeat
protocol.method_order: seeded random permutation per field and repeat
protocol.reused_rows: same-A amortized scenario only; setup excluded, not the fresh-field experiment
protocol.runtime_warmup: one discarded field per N/kappa; fresh-A setup remains timed
protocol.scope: assembled A and neural prediction already available; residual included for every method
